releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.28
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.28**: 11 cumulative changes since 0.1.25.

0.1.26 was not published. 0.1.27 subsequently published after its native
qualification passed on a later run. This release adds the real Home lifecycle
qualification repair and retains the cumulative changes below. The tagged
source notes' statement that 0.1.27 was unpublished is stale; this paragraph
corrects publication metadata only. Tags and archives remain unchanged.

- Background native qualification through Home (#2546)
- Preserve native headings on rune dev bd4d42b (#2539)
- Adopt the embossed fox app icon from brand 1.6.0 (#2535)
- Signed apt, dnf and aur packages so linux updates come with the system (#2533)
- The quick terminal's bottom edge stops at the Dock (#2529)
- Take the app's own titlebar on linux (#2515)
- End onboarding with an agent running (#2510)
- Quick look, finder service and hover toolbar (#2514)
- What works here for each machine (#2512)
- Light on gnome default; no tip after onboarding; view → playground (#2508)
- Stop promising permissions where there are none (#2509)

## [0.151.0](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/compare/v0.150.0...v0.151.0) (2026-11-15)


### Features

* **brand:** adopt the embossed fox app icon from brand 1.6.0 ([#2535](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/issues/2535)) ([d254024](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/d2540249ccce4522bfb803ed0d1e8e4c394d0e1e))
* **release:** signed apt, dnf and aur packages so linux updates come with the system ([#2533](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/issues/2533)) ([0a8c366](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/0a8c366724f46f4649ab4f89e3063c997da60eec))


### Bug Fixes

* **ci:** hide git from zig so fork tags cannot break from-source ffi builds ([#2542](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/issues/2542)) ([7662f71](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/7662f71404e0b61861b8e236f8515976fa71052d))
* **cli:** read and write PHUX_TERMINAL_ID in one form ([f7bc764](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/f7bc764daa521dd687efe60c5a6709f79490de2d))
* **server:** believe relayed identity from a hub paired before scope v2 ([#2536](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/issues/2536)) ([854eca9](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/854eca91fd8cadec394c11cb68677213442e583c))
* **usage:** clear a rejection with its error ([4272d3e](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/4272d3e55c3eff80ae8c088b7f69ec68852f4c1f))


### Refactors

* **agent-session:** one map of marks per terminal in the arbiter ([3479a42](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/3479a4254ef91d3d7cbdf567a67082111a26b3e9))
* **client-ffi:** drop write-only expected_attach_id and keep the viewport under one lock ([54eafd8](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/54eafd849602af6f888109a25e454b1cdc99cba2))
* **client:** derive duplicated limits from their sources ([cd34b32](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/cd34b3204fe615f064aad58e72cfef32be2963d0))
* **client:** read $PHUX_SSH in one place ([c69720e](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/c69720e8d69817cb4e0b7698d24e940e50489a22))
* **client:** take exec-state and lifetime words from phux-core ([902da5f](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/902da5f4dc9408c776073f97ad9d3b35d91ff6df))
* **cli:** explicit states for rebind wait, unit sections and update plans ([eeec3df](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/eeec3df12b6124c9d370c367ae96d55f639b57f2))
* **mcp:** one signal table and one bounded timeout parser ([0983b5e](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/0983b5e03f0f25a3d04b10adcb93c7612ca06a40))
* **protocol:** wire_enum declares every value as ALL ([993eca7](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/993eca7e7e09e7e17a71ad2eddf4ba9f9a5678b1))
* **server:** one definition for quic auth code, link timings and native launch env ([f754ef4](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/f754ef41894a89df3f39a3c47bfc04fbd89aa106))
* **terminal:** derive the agent detector's cadence from its state ([5b2ea12](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/5b2ea12e8758cd18e6cc22291af7c5e65e83ec93))
* **terminal:** launch owns the pane command helpers and their keys ([58c8bf2](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/58c8bf2dc50a6fe24d74bd6bcdbf9d331c090ba2))
* **terminal:** one table names the osc 7501 record states ([c9a5f0a](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/c9a5f0a79118bbdbaeff4708ba54ae2ecc1aa8dc))
* **terminal:** the resync debounce owes an optional debt ([22ab370](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/22ab370f0d85854517358acb358d3648cb0d6a10))
* **tui:** hold the settings snapshot as one load result ([295fc08](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/295fc08bba8573511f25578675b54fc3fe012185))
* **tui:** park splits on one adopt enum shared with windows ([f537f9b](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/f537f9bd7f38881e5abbd6a9c947e2727b163d06))
* **tui:** parse agent scopes from their names and labels ([c8712cc](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/c8712ccedb612dcac4cf21ad040d70bdc30409ba))
* **tui:** pin the copy-mode anchor as one value ([dda37ac](https://github.com/no-phux/phux/commit/dda37acbbecead83a0715e6cdbe644818aa9c35d))
* **tui:** track an osc 52 read as o

releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.27**: 10 changes since 0.1.25.

0.1.26 was not published: its cold iOS source-build qualification failed before publication. This release includes those changes as well as the newer fixes. The current release source and artifacts are qualified through the normal exact-SHA CI/native gates; no tag or archive is rewritten.

- Preserve native headings on rune dev bd4d42b (#2539)
- Adopt the embossed fox app icon from brand 1.6.0 (#2535)
- Signed apt, dnf and aur packages so linux updates come with the system (#2533)
- The quick terminal's bottom edge stops at the Dock (#2529)
- Take the app's own titlebar on linux (#2515)
- End onboarding with an agent running (#2510)
- Quick look, finder service and hover toolbar (#2514)

- Light on gnome default; no tip after onboarding; view → playground (#2508)
